content: {"parts":[{"id":"P1","status":"answered","claims":[{"text":"They evaluate on the original MS-COCO English dataset restricted to the sportball category, called 'English-sportball', consisting of 3,850 sportball images, which is first evaluated to provide base results for the following comparisons.","evidence_ids":["ev_0151611ba7eeeca1366dd511"]},{"text":"Their experiments and comparisons are conducted through three datasets of the same size and sportball images: two Vietnamese datasets (Google-translated and human-annotated) and the original MS-COCO English dataset, split into 2,695 training, 924 validation and 231 test images.","evidence_ids":["ev_d5bd4336ddc8ae74325312d6"]},{"text":"The English dataset used for comparison is the original MS-COCO (Microsoft Common in Objects in Context) dataset, whose English captions categorized with sportball were used to train the Pytorch-tutorial and NIC Show-and-Tell models.","evidence_ids":["ev_19fbe3a0bc8aa729bc33f1e8","ev_145e091e4bb996a8db449a0c"]}],"missing":[]}]}
